verdict.rationale: LobeChat's desktop app ships an actual terminal (docs-7) and supports installing local MCP connectors that 'live on your machine or your local network' (docs-5/27) plus a guided flow to connect a local Agent (docs-4/26), which together enable an exec surface via MCP tool use rather than pure chat. However, the docs describe infrastructure/UI for terminals and connectors rather than explicit first-party proof that the assistant itself autonomously runs shell commands or edits files end-to-end, and there's no independent hands-on report confirming this works reliably. missing for 10: explicit documentation/demo of the agent autonomously executing commands and editing files (not just UI terminal tabs or MCP install flow), independent/hands-on verification of real exec behavior.
